items.title: Sammy Penn Interview, 1960-04-21
items.q: Well I did play off and on as a spare man, extra man. Whenever someone, when he'd need a saxophone player, I'd play with him.

ctx.x: There's one thing the other day you mentioned, you'll ask Manuel Paul a little bit about his playing with Celestan, you mentioned that you made a movie with him. I think we might put that on the thing.

Yes, I made a picture with him at the old Absinthe House. That was the Cinorama Holiday I believe. That's right, that's right. With the big three dimension screen. Yeah, it's taken us about 12 hours to make that picture. Really? About 12 hours. It's a good movie alright. And that's the hardest job, that's the hardest job I have ever had in my life. Did you play with Celestan otherwise much? Well I did play off and on as a spare man, extra man. Whenever someone, when he'd need a saxophone player, I'd play with…
Was there any other point that you forgot to tell us the other day that you wanted to make a note of?
